n-k-l1b-02.title: Baabuurta bas ee kee ayay Hana maanta qaadanaysaa?
n-k-l1b-02.topic: Hangul nolosha dhabta ah: looxa joogsiga baska
n-k-l1b-02.goal: Go'aamin macluumaadka looxa baska iyo fariinta ku jira kuwa loo baahan yahay si loo magacaabo baska saxda ah, ogow shuruudda ku qoran qaybta kala-bar, oo sharax doorashadaada.
n-k-l1b-02.material:
Adiga iyo saaxiibkaa Hana waxaad joogtaan joogsi bas oo la yiraahdo 시장 앞. Maalmaha: 월 Isniin, 화 Salaasa, 수 Arbaca, 목 Khamiis, 금 Jimce, 토 Sabti, 일 Axad. 매일 = maalin kasta.

[버스 정류장: 시장 앞]
3번 (월~금): 학교 · 병원
5번 (매일): 공원 · 병원 · 역
7번 (매일): 시장 · 학교

Fariinta Hana: "오늘은 일요일이에요. 병원에 가요. 몇 번 버스예요?"
n-k-l1b-02.prereq.1: Wuxuu yaqaan maalmaha toddobaadka (월 ~ 일), tirooyinka + 번
n-k-l1b-02.s.s1.prompt: Si aad Hana ugu sheegto lambarka baska, macluumaadkee ayaad u baahan tahay? Dooro dhammaan kuwa quseeya.
n-k-l1b-02.s.s1.hint.0: Marka hore qor wixii Hana rabto inay sameyso, dabadeed weydii qaybta looxa ee ka jawaabaysa.
n-k-l1b-02.s.s1.hint.1: Akhri wixii lagu qoray kala-bar lambar bas kasta ka dambeeya. Xaqiiqada maanta ku saabsan maxaad u baahan tahay si aad u isticmaasho?
n-k-l1b-02.s.s1.r.b: Hore ayaad joogsiga u joogtaa. Looxu waa isku mid magac kasta oo uu leeyahay, sidaa darteed magaca joogsigu ma go'aamiyo baska.
n-k-l1b-02.s.s1.o.e: Intee in le'eg ayuu baska ku kacaa
n-k-l1b-02.s.s1.r.e: Qiimuhu ma beddelo baska meesha tagaya, looxuna ma tusayo qiime.
n-k-l1b-02.s.s1.explain: Waxaad u baahan tahay meesha (병원), khadadka looxa ee taxaya, iyo maalinta maanta, sababtoo ah 3번 wuxuu socdaa 월~금 oo keliya. Magaca joogsiga iyo kharashka lama kaashanayo doorashada lambarka.
n-k-l1b-02.s.s2.prompt: Baska kee ayay Hana maanta qaadanaysaa?
n-k-l1b-02.s.s2.hint.0: Ka tirtir baska liiskiisu aanu magacaabin meesha.
n-k-l1b-02.s.s2.hint.1: Baska harsan, ku hubi kala-barka maalinta maanta.
n-k-l1b-02.s.s2.r.a: 3번 wuxuu tagaa 병원, laakiin kala-barku wuxuu leeyahay wuxuu socdaa 월~금 oo keliya, maantana waa 일요일.
n-k-l1b-02.s.s2.r.b: 7번 wuxuu tagaa 시장 iyo 학교. 병원 liiskiisa kuma jirto.
n-k-l1b-02.s.s2.r.d: Labaduba waxay taxaan 병원, laakiin 3번 maanta ma socdo, sidaa darteed isku mid ma aha.
n-k-l1b-02.s.s2.explain: 5번 wuxuu taxaa 병원 wuxuuna socdaa 매일. 3번 sidoo kale wuxuu taxaa 병원 laakiin wuxuu socdaa 월~금 oo keliya, maantana waa Axad.
n-k-l1b-02.s.s3.prompt: U jawaab Hana Ingiriis (waxaad ku dari kartaa ereyo Kuuriyaan ah): baska kee ayay qaadanaysaa, maxaana ugu jirin baska kale ee halkaas tagaya?
n-k-l1b-02.s.s3.hint.0: Marka hore sheeg lambarka baska, dabadeed sababta ku sheeg hal weedh.
n-k-l1b-02.s.s3.hint.1: Sheeg maalinta ku jirta fariinta maanta iyo kala-barka baska kale.
n-k-l1b-02.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Miyaan magacaabay hal bas oo aan sheegay sababta maanta u shaqeynayo?
n-k-l1b-02.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Miyaan sheegay sababta baska kale maanta u shaqeyn waayo?
n-k-l1b-02.s.s3.model.0: Qaado baska 5. Baska 3 sidoo kale wuxuu tagaa isbitaalka, laakiin wuxuu socdaa Isniinta ilaa Jimcaha oo keliya, maantana waa Axad.
n-k-l1b-02.s.s3.model.1: 5번 waa kan saxda ah. 3번 waa 월~금 oo keliya, sidaa darteed Axadda ma socdo.
n-k-l1b-02.s.s3.model.2: Hana waa inay qaadato 5. Baska 3 wuxuu leeyahay Mon-Fri oo keliya, laakiin maanta waa 일요일.

n-k-l1b-03.s.s1.hint.0: Go'aami adigoo isticmaalaya waxa aad ilaa hadda akhrisay oo keliya.
n-k-l1b-03.title: Laba kaadh magac, hal qoys?
n-k-l1b-03.topic: Hangul nolosha dhabta ah: akhrinta magacyada iyo kaadhadhka magaca
n-k-l1b-03.goal: Akhri kaadhadhka magaca Kuuriya, ogow qaybta magaca qoyska ah, oo dib u eeg male-awaal ku saabsan sida laba qof isugu dhow yihiin marka macluumaad cusub yimaado.
n-k-l1b-03.material: Maalinta koowaad ee fasalka Kuuriya. Waxaad akhrisaa kaadhadhka magaca ee miisaska saaran oo dhegaysataa dadka naftooda soo bandhigaya. Magacyada Kuuriya waxaa lagu qoraa magaca qoyska marka hore, dabadeed magaca la siiyay. Fasalkan magac qoys kastaa wuxuu leeyahay hal dhawaaq (sida 박, 김, 이). Kaadhadhku ma laha meel bannaan oo u dhexeysa.
n-k-l1b-03.thinking.0: Kala saarida wixii magac muujiyo iyo wixii uusan muujin
n-k-l1b-03.thinking.1: Dib u eegista xukun marka macluumaad cusub yimaado
n-k-l1b-03.thinking.2: Kala saarida wax hubaal ah iyo wax suurtagal ah
n-k-l1b-03.prereq.1: Wuxuu yaqaan 동생 (walaal ka yar), 저는 ~이에요, ~씨
n-k-l1b-03.s.s1.prompt: Akhri qayb kasta oo dooro weedhda aad ugu hubtid. Dabadeed sii wad.
n-k-l1b-03.s.s1.hint.1: Is weydii: tani miyay hubaal tahay, mise suurtagal oo keliya?
n-k-l1b-03.s.s1.st.0.info:
Laba kaadh magac oo miisaska saaran:
박지민
박지훈
n-k-l1b-03.s.s1.st.0.ask: Maxaad si hubaal ah u sheegi kartaa?
n-k-l1b-03.s.s1.st.0.after: Labada kaadhba waxay ku bilaabmaan 박, sidaa darteed magaca qoysku waa isku mid. Kaadhadhku keligood ma muujiyaan in labadu isku dhow yihiin.
n-k-l1b-03.s.s1.st.0.r.a: Waa suurtagal, laakiin ma hubo. 박 waa magac qoys oo aad u badan, sidaa darteed dadka haysta inta badan isku dhow ma aha.
n-k-l1b-03.s.s1.st.0.o.c: Waxay leeyihiin isku magac la siiyay.
n-k-l1b-03.s.s1.st.0.r.c: Magacyada la siiyay way kala duwan yihiin (지민 iyo 지훈).
n-k-l1b-03.s.s1.st.0.r.d: Laba kaadh oo laba miis saaran. Magacyada la siiyay sidoo kale way kala duwan yihiin.
n-k-l1b-03.s.s1.st.1.ask: Hadda maxaad ka taqaan 지민 iyo 지훈?
n-k-l1b-03.s.s1.st.1.after: 지훈 si toos ah ayuu u yidhi: 지민 waa walaalkiis/walaashiis ka yar. Sidaa darteed magaca qoyska 박 isku mid ah halkan qoys ayuu ku habboonaa, laakiin waxaan uga ogaanay wuxuu sheegay oo keliya.
n-k-l1b-03.s.s1.st.1.o.a: 지민 waa walaalka ama walaasha 지훈 ka yar.
n-k-l1b-03.s.s1.st.1.r.b: 지훈 wuxuu yiraahdaa 지민 waa 제 동생, 'walaalkay ka yar', ma aha macallin.
n-k-l1b-03.s.s1.st.1.o.c: 지민 waa walaasha 지훈 ka weyn.
n-k-l1b-03.s.s1.st.1.r.c: 동생 macnaheedu waa walaal ka yar. Walaasha ka weyn waxay noqon lahayd 누나 ama 언니.
n-k-l1b-03.s.s1.st.1.r.d: 지훈 wuxuu yiraahdaa 제 동생, sidaa darteed waa qoys, ma aha fasal-wadaagayaal oo keliya.
n-k-l1b-03.s.s1.st.2.ask: Miyuu 지민 yahay wiil mise gabadh?
n-k-l1b-03.s.s1.st.2.after: '동생' iyo da'du ma sheegaan jinsiga, magaca 지민 labadaba waa loo isticmaalaa. Illaa hadda waxba ma muujinayaan in 지민 yahay wiil mise gabadh.
n-k-l1b-03.s.s1.st.2.o.a: Gabadh, maxaa yeelay 지민 wuxuu u egyahay magac gabadh.
n-k-l1b-03.s.s1.st.2.r.a: Magaca 지민 waxaa loo isticmaalaa wiilal iyo gabdhoba, sidaa darteed magacu caddayn ma aha.
n-k-l1b-03.s.s1.st.2.o.b: Wiil, maxaa yeelay 지훈 waa wiil oo isku magac qoys bay leeyihiin.
n-k-l1b-03.s.s1.st.2.r.b: Magaca qoyska waxaa wadaaga qof kasta oo qoyska ah, wuxuuna waxba ka sheegayn inuu qofku yahay wiil mise gabadh.
n-k-l1b-03.s.s1.st.2.o.c: Wali ma ognin. Wax la yidhi illaa hadda ma muujinayaan.
n-k-l1b-03.s.s1.st.2.o.d: Wiil, maxaa yeelay walaalaha waaweyn waa wiilal.
n-k-l1b-03.s.s1.st.2.r.d: 지훈 waa kan ka weyn. Wax ma sheegaan in kan ka weyn yahay wiil, waxna lagama yidhi kan ka yar.
n-k-l1b-03.s.s1.reflect: Magacu wuxuu muujiyaa magaca qoyska iyo magaca la siiyay, ma muujiyo in dadku isku dhow yihiin ama qofku yahay wiil mise gabadh. Macluumaad cusub kasta wuxuu yareeyay wixii aan ognayn, waxaana kala saarnay 'suurtagal' iyo 'hubaal'.
n-k-l1b-03.s.s2.prompt: Hadda adigu waxaad tahay 박지민 oo ku jirta mowqifkaaga inaad is soo bandhigto. Ku qor laba sadar oo gaagaaban Kuuriyaan (hadal dabacsan): salaan, dabadeed sheeg magacaaga.
n-k-l1b-03.s.s2.hint.0: Ku bilow salaanta aad fasalka ku isticmaasho.
n-k-l1b-03.s.s2.hint.1: Ka fikir sida magac si edeb leh loo yiraahdo: dhammaadkee ayaa raacaya, magacaaguna ma ku dhammaadaa shibbane hoose?
n-k-l1b-03.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Miyaan salaamay oo sheegay magacayga laba sadar?
n-k-l1b-03.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Miyaan magaca qoyska marka hore dhigay haddii aan labada qaybood sheegay?
n-k-l1b-03.s.s2.modelNote.3: Sidoo kale waa dabiici: shaqaalaha 저는 waa laga tagi karaa.

n-k-l1c-01.title: Yaa baraya yaa sawirka?
n-k-l1c-01.topic: Mawduuc, shay iyo particles: yaa maxaa sameeya
n-k-l1c-01.goal: Go'aami qoraallada sawirka ku habboon, tijaabi tilmaantaada qoraal cusub, oo sharax sababta qoraal u eg uu macne lid ah u leeyahay.
n-k-l1c-01.material: Wargeys fasal wuxuu leeyahay sawir: 수진 wuxuu baraya 민수 sawir gacmeed. Shan arday ayaa soo jeediya qoraal sawir. Erayada: 가르쳐요 = baro(baraa). Particles: 이/가 waxay raacaan midka wax sameeya; 은/는 waxay raacaan mawduuca ("sida ... ku saabsan"); 을/를 waxay raacaan midka ficilka lagu sameeyo.
n-k-l1c-01.thinking.0: Kala saarista doorarka iyadoo la raacayo calaamadaha, ma aha booska
n-k-l1c-01.thinking.1: Isticmaalka cadayn si loo diido akhrin soo jiidasho leh
n-k-l1c-01.thinking.2: Sharaxidda qaanuun qof ku fikira nidaamka erayada Ingiriis
n-k-l1c-01.prereq.1: Wuxuu la kulmay 이/가 iyo 을/를 (sameeyaha iyo qaataha)
n-k-l1c-01.s.s1.prompt: Sawirka, 수진 wuxuu baraya 민수. Qoraallee ayaa sharxaya sawirkan? Dooro dhammaan kuwa quseeya.
n-k-l1c-01.s.s1.hint.0: Ha akhrin magacyada bidix ilaa midig. Marka hore hel magaca leh 이/가 ama 은/는 iyo kan leh 을/를.
n-k-l1c-01.s.s1.hint.1: Qoraal kasta weydii: yaa leh 를 (ama 을) kadib magaca, qofkaas ma la baray mise wuu baraa?
n-k-l1c-01.s.s1.r.b: Particle-ka 가 wuxuu ku jiraa 민수, sidaas darteed 민수 halkan waa kan baraya. Taasi waa lidka sawirka.
n-k-l1c-01.s.s1.r.d: 수진 wuu horreeyaa, laakiin 을 wuxuu ku jiraa 수진: waa kan la baro 민수-na wuu baraa. Nidaamka erayadu ma aha tilmaanta.
n-k-l1c-01.s.s1.explain: Gudaha a, c iyo e, 수진 wuxuu leeyahay 이/가 ama 은/는 (kan wax sameeya ama mawduuca) 민수-na wuxuu leeyahay 를 (kan la baray). Nidaamka labada magac wuu beddeli karaa; particles-ku waxay ilaaliyaan doorarka.
n-k-l1c-01.s.s2.prompt: Qoraal cusub ayaa soo muuqda: 동생을 엄마가 안아요. (안아요 = duufsada, 엄마 = hooyo, 동생 = walaal yar.) Yaa duufsada yaa?
n-k-l1c-01.s.s2.hint.0: Hel particle-ka magac kasta ka dib ka hor intaadan akhrin nidaamka.
n-k-l1c-01.s.s2.hint.1: Weydii particle-ka calaamadeeya kan wax sameeya iyo kan calaamadeeya kan helaya.
n-k-l1c-01.s.s2.o.a: 엄마 wuxuu duufsadaa 동생, sababtoo ah 엄마 wuxuu leeyahay 가 동생-na wuxuu leeyahay 을.
n-k-l1c-01.s.s2.o.b: 동생 wuxuu duufsadaa 엄마, sababtoo ah 동생 waa magacii ugu horreeyay weedha.
n-k-l1c-01.s.s2.r.b: Magaca koowaad si toos ah ma aha kan wax sameeya. 동생 wuxuu leeyahay 을, sidaas darteed 동생 waa kan la duufsaday.
n-k-l1c-01.s.s2.o.c: Way is duufsadaan, sababtoo ah labada magac labaduba waxay leeyihiin particle.
n-k-l1c-01.s.s2.r.c: Labada particle way kala duwan yihiin. 가 wuxuu calaamadeeyaa kan duufsada 을-na kan la duufsado.
n-k-l1c-01.s.s2.o.d: Ma ogaan karno, sababtoo ah magacyada waxay ku jiraan nidaam aan caadi ahayn.
n-k-l1c-01.s.s2.r.d: Waad ogaan kartaa: particles-ku waxay ilaaliyaan doorarka xitaa marka nidaamku beddelmo.
n-k-l1c-01.s.s2.explain: 가 wuxuu ku jiraa 엄마 (kan duufsada) 을-na wuxuu ku jiraa 동생 (kan la duufsado), sidaas darteed qoraalku macnaheedu waa hooyo ayaa duufsata walaalkeeda yar. Particles-ka, ma aha nidaamka, ayaa bixiya doorarka.
n-k-l1c-01.s.s3.prompt: Saaxiib ayaa akhriya nidaamka erayada Ingiriis wuxuuna leeyahay: "수진을 민수가 가르쳐요 wuxuu ku bilaabmaa 수진, sidaas darteed 수진 wuu baraa." Hal ama laba weedhood oo Ingiriis ah, sharax sababta qoraalkani ugu HABBOON sawirka.
n-k-l1c-01.s.s3.hint.0: Tilmaan particle-ka agtiisa ee 수진 iyo particle-ka agtiisa ee 민수.
n-k-l1c-01.s.s3.hint.1: Dheh waxa particle kasta kuu sheegayo oo ku saabsan doorka magaciisa.
n-k-l1c-01.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ma magacaabay particle-ka 수진 ku jira?
n-k-l1c-01.s.s3.model.0: 수진 wuxuu leeyahay particle-ka 을, sidaas darteed waa kan la baro; 민수 wuxuu leeyahay 가, sidaas darteed 민수 wuu baraa. Boosku ma go'aamiyo.
n-k-l1c-01.s.s3.model.1: Particles-ku waxay muujiyaan doorarka, ma aha nidaamka: 을 wuxuu calaamadeeyaa 수진 sida qaataha 가-na 민수 sida sameeyaha, sidaas darteed wuxuu leeyahay 민수 wuxuu baraa 수진.
n-k-l1c-01.s.s3.model.2: Sababtoo ah 가 wuxuu muujiyaa in 민수 yahay kan baraya.

n-k-l1c-02.title: Xaggee 민호 wuxuu sameeyaa maxay? Hubinta maalinlaha
n-k-l1c-02.topic: Particles-ka meesha: 에 (tag, ahow) vs 에서 (samee)
n-k-l1c-02.goal: Hel sadarrada maalinle gaaban ee particle-ka meesha khaldan la isticmaalay, dheh qaanuunka kala saara 에 iyo 에서, oo hagaaji sadarrada.
n-k-l1c-02.material: Arday baranaya, 민호, wuxuu u qoraa maalintiisa Kuuriyaan ahaan. Qaar ka mid ah particles-ka meesha waa khalad. Erayada: 아침 = subax, 점심 = qado, 오후 = galab, 저녁 = fiid, 운동해요 = jimicsi (sameeya).
n-k-l1c-02.thinking.0: Ogaanshaha khalad adigoo sadar kasta ka hubinaya qaanuun
n-k-l1c-02.prereq.1: Wuxuu yaqaan 에 iyo 에서 inay jiraan (particles-ka meesha)
n-k-l1c-02.s.s1.prompt: Kani waa maalinlaha 민호 ee hal maalin. Qaar ka mid ah sadarrada waxay leeyihiin khalad particle-ka meesha (in ka badan hal ayaa jira). Dooro sadar kasta oo leh.
n-k-l1c-02.s.s1.hint.0: Hoos u xariiq falka iyo particle-ka meesha sadar kasta. Sadarrada kee ayaa isu eg?
n-k-l1c-02.s.s1.hint.1: U kala saar sadarrada kooxo iyadoo la raacayo falkooda, oo arag particle-ka koox kasta isticmaasho.
n-k-l1c-02.s.s1.explain: Sadarrada 3, 5 iyo 7 waa khalad: 도서관에서 책을 읽어요 (ficil meel ka dhaca), 집에 있어요 (ahaanshaha meel), 공원에서 운동해요 (ficil meel ka dhaca). Sadarrada 1, 2, 4 iyo 6 waa fiican yihiin.
n-k-l1c-02.s.s2.prompt: Qaanuunkee ayaa sharxa farqiga 에 iyo 에서 maalinlahan?
n-k-l1c-02.s.s2.hint.0: U kala saar sadarrada saxda ah falalkooda: falalkee ayaa la socda 에 kuwee-na 에서?
n-k-l1c-02.s.s2.hint.1: Weydii: falku ma wuxuu leeyahay qofku wuu dhaqaaqaa ama wuu joogaa, mise qofku wax buu halkaas ka sameeyaa?
n-k-l1c-02.s.s2.o.a: 에 wuxuu muujiyaa meesha ficil ka dhaca; 에서 wuxuu muujiyaa meesha qof tago ama joogo.
n-k-l1c-02.s.s2.r.a: Taasi waa rogan. Hubi 학교에 가요 (tag) iyo 식당에서 먹어요 (halkaas ku cun).
n-k-l1c-02.s.s2.o.b: 에 waa meelo waaweyn sida dugsi; 에서 waa meelo yaryar sida qol.
n-k-l1c-02.s.s2.r.b: Cabbirku muhiim maaha: 학교에서 iyo 집에서 labaduba waa fiican yihiin ficil.
n-k-l1c-02.s.s2.o.c: 에 iyo 에서 macnahoodu waa isku mid; mid kasta fal kasta ayuu la shaqeeyaa.
n-k-l1c-02.s.s2.r.c: Way kala duwan yihiin: 도서관에 책을 읽어요 wuxuu ugu dhawaaqaa khalad dadka Kuuriyaanka ah.
n-k-l1c-02.s.s2.o.d: 에서 wuxuu muujiyaa meesha ficil ka dhaca; 에 wuxuu muujiyaa meesha qof tago ama joogo.
n-k-l1c-02.s.s2.explain: 에서 = meesha aad wax ka sameyso (cun, akhri, baro, jimicsi). 에 = meesha aad tagto, ama halka qof ama shay yaal (가요, 와요, 있어요).
n-k-l1c-02.s.s3.prompt: Hadda dib u qor sadar KASTA oo lahaa khaladka, si sax ah. Qor weedhaha la saxay Kuuriyaan ahaan oo ilaali falalka.
n-k-l1c-02.s.s3.hint.0: Sadar kasta oo khaldan go'aami: qofku ma tago ama joogaa halkaas, mise wax buu halkaas ka sameeyaa?
n-k-l1c-02.s.s3.hint.1: Cod dheer u akhri weedhaada: qofku ma wax buu meesha ka sameeyaa, mise wuu tagaa ama joogaa halkaas?

n-k-l1d-02.title: Liiska saaxiib ee dukaanka qalabka
n-k-l1d-02.goal: U beddel qoraal Kuuriyaan ah oo gaaban iyo miis qiimeyn dhowr sanduuq oo wax-iibsi oo buuxiya shuruud kasta, ka dibna ka warbixi hal sanduuq Kuuriyaan.
n-k-l1d-02.material:
Saaxiibkaa ayaa kuu diraya fariin ka hor intaadan aadin dukaanka qalabka:

"편의점에 가요? 부탁해요!
칠천오백 원 있어요.
물 두 개 사요.
김밥하고 빵도 사요.
모두 일곱 개 사요."

[가격표]
물 한 개: 오백 원
빵 한 개: 천 원
김밥 한 개: 이천 원
김밥 두 개: 사천 원
김밥 세 개: 사천오백 원
김밥 네 개: 육천 원

(Qoraalku wuxuu leeyahay: saaxiibkaa ayaa haysta 7,500 won, iibsanaya 2 dhalo biyo ah, rabo gimbap iyo rooti sidoo kale, wadar ahaanna iibsanaya 7 shay.)
n-k-l1d-02.thinking.1: Akhrinta miis qiimeyn ah oo aan ahayn qiime lagu dhufto tirada oo keliya
n-k-l1d-02.prereq.1: Wuxuu yaqaan tirooyinka Sino-Kuuriyaanka ilaa kumanyaal (천, 오백, 칠천) iyo 원
n-k-l1d-02.prereq.2: Wuxuu yaqaan tirinta hooyo leh 개 (한 개 ... 일곱 개)
n-k-l1d-02.s.s1.prompt: Eeg xariiqyada gimbap ee liiska qiimaha. Sheegashadee ayaa run ah?
n-k-l1d-02.s.s1.hint.0: Akhri xariiq kasta oo gimbap sida 'tirada gimbap: qiimaha dhammaantood'.
n-k-l1d-02.s.s1.hint.1: Is barbardhig qiimaha tirada gimbap kasta iyo qiimaha hal gimbap.
n-k-l1d-02.s.s1.o.a: Gimbap-ku waa ka rakhiis badan qaybta kasta marka aad badan iibsato: 3 waxay ku kacaan 4,500 won.
n-k-l1d-02.s.s1.o.b: Gimbap kasta waxay ku kacaysaa 2,000 won, sidaas darteed 3 gimbap waxay ku kacaan 6,000 won.
n-k-l1d-02.s.s1.r.b: Liiska wuxuu leeyahay 세 개: 사천오백 원, sidaas darteed 3 gimbap waxay ku kacaan 4,500 won, ma aha 6,000.
n-k-l1d-02.s.s1.o.c: Gimbap-ku wuu sii qaaliyaa: 4 gimbap waxay ku kacaan 8,000 won.
n-k-l1d-02.s.s1.r.c: Liiska wuxuu leeyahay 네 개: 육천 원, sidaas darteed 4 gimbap waxay ku kacaan 6,000 won.
n-k-l1d-02.s.s1.o.d: Laba gimbap waxay ku kacaan 3,000 won, mid ka rakhiis badan 1 + 1.
n-k-l1d-02.s.s1.r.d: Liiska wuxuu leeyahay 두 개: 사천 원, sidaas darteed 2 gimbap waxay ku kacaan 4,000 won.
n-k-l1d-02.s.s1.explain: Miiska wuxuu liis garaynayaa qiimaha urur oo dhan: 1 gimbap 2,000, 2 gimbap 4,000, 3 gimbap 4,500, 4 gimbap 6,000. Qiimuhu had iyo goor ma aha 2,000 oo lagu dhufto tirada.
n-k-l1d-02.s.s2.prompt: Hel 2 sanduuq oo kala duwan oo ku habboon WAX KASTA oo qoraalka ku jira. g = tirada gimbap, b = tirada rootiga (2 dhalo biyo ah horeba waa go'an yihiin).
n-k-l1d-02.s.s2.hint.0: Marka hore qor shuruudaha erayadaada: lacagta intee le'eg, imisa shay wadar ahaan, maxaa lagu daraa.
n-k-l1d-02.s.s2.hint.1: Tiri 2 dhalo biyo ah sidoo kale. Ka dibna isku day tirooyinka suurtagalka ah ee gimbap mid mid.
n-k-l1d-02.s.s2.hint.2: Isku day kasta ku dar biyo, gimbap (laga bilaabo LIISKA) iyo rooti, ka dibna is barbardhig 7,500 won.
n-k-l1d-02.s.s2.ok.c1: Gimbap iyo rooti labadaba waa lagu daray.
n-k-l1d-02.s.s2.fail.c1: 김밥하고 빵도 사요: iibso ugu yaraan mid kasta.
n-k-l1d-02.s.s2.ok.c2: Wadar ahaan toddoba shay oo leh 2 dhalo biyo ah.
n-k-l1d-02.s.s2.fail.c2: 모두 일곱 개: leh 2 dhalo biyo ah, gimbap oo lagu daray rooti waa inay noqdaan 5.
n-k-l1d-02.s.s2.fail.c3: Ka badan 7,500 won (칠천오백 원). Xusuuso biyuhu wadar ahaan waxay ku kacaan 1,000 won oo isticmaal LIISKA qiimaha gimbap.
n-k-l1d-02.s.s2.explain: Waxaa jira laba sanduuq oo sax ah: 1 gimbap + 4 rooti (biyo 1,000 + 2,000 + 4,000 = 7,000 won) iyo 3 gimbap + 2 rooti (1,000 + 4,500 + 2,000 = 7,500 won). 2 gimbap + 3 rooti waxay ku kacaan 8,000 iyo 4 gimbap + 1 rooti waxay ku kacaan 8,000, taasoo aad u badan. Isticmaalka liiska qiimaha, ma aha 2,000 oo lagu dhufto tirada, ayaa ka dhigaya 3 gimbap inay ku habboonaadaan.
n-k-l1d-02.s.s2.because.prompt: Dooro HAL ka mid ah sanduuqyadaada oo u dir saaxiibkaa fariin Kuuriyaan ah (edeb -요): imisa gimbap, imisa rooti iyo wadarta qiimaha oo ay ku jiraan biyaha.
n-k-l1d-02.s.s2.because.hint.0: Isticmaal mid ka mid ah sanduuqyadaada tallaabadii hore.
n-k-l1d-02.s.s2.because.hint.1: Dheh tirada gimbap, tirada rootiga, ka dibna wadarta won ahaan.
n-k-l1d-02.s.s2.because.selfAssess.0: Tirooyinka fariintayda ma waafaqsan yihiin hal sanduuq oo aan dhisay?
n-k-l1d-02.s.s2.because.selfAssess.1: Wadarta ma sax tahay (biyo 1,000 + gimbap laga bilaabo liiska + rooti 1,000 mid kasta)?

n-k-l1d-03.title: Saddex calaamadood oo dukaanka midhaha
n-k-l1d-03.goal: Cusboonaysii qiimaha aad filayso saddex tufaax marka calaamado badan muuqdaan, ka dibna weydii saddex tufaax si sax ah Kuuriyaan.
n-k-l1d-03.material: Maanta waxaad joogtaa dukaan midho yar. Waxaad rabtaa 3 tufaax. Waxaad akhrisaa calaamadaha mid mid marka aad dhowaato taagga.
n-k-l1d-03.thinking.0: Dib u eegista gabagabo marka macluumaad cusub yimaado
n-k-l1d-03.thinking.1: Isticmaalka xeerka ugu gaarka ah halkii mid guud
n-k-l1d-03.thinking.2: Tirinta adigoo isticmaalaya tirooyin hooyo (세 개)
n-k-l1d-03.prereq.1: Wuxuu yaqaan qiimayaasha Sino-Kuuriyaanka (이천 원, 오천 원, 사천 원)
n-k-l1d-03.prereq.2: Wuxuu yaqaan 한 개, 두 개, 세 개 iyo 주세요, 얼마예요
n-k-l1d-03.s.s1.prompt: Akhri calaamad kasta, dooro qiimaha aad filayso inaad bixiso 3 tufaax, ka dibna sii wad.
n-k-l1d-03.s.s1.hint.0: Isticmaal calaamadaha aad horeba u akhrisay oo keliya.
n-k-l1d-03.s.s1.hint.1: Calaamad cusub kasta weydii: ma waafaqsan tahay imisa aad rabto, iyo goorta aad iibsanayso?
n-k-l1d-03.s.s1.st.0.info: Calaamadda taagga: 사과 한 개: 이천 원
n-k-l1d-03.s.s1.st.0.ask: Waxaad rabtaa 3 tufaax. Imisa ayaad filaysaa inaad bixiso?
n-k-l1d-03.s.s1.st.0.after: Calaamaddan oo keliya, 3 x 2,000 = 6,000 won waa jawaabta macquulka ah.
n-k-l1d-03.s.s1.st.0.r.b: Taasi waa qiimaha HAL tufaax. Waxaad rabtaa saddex.
n-k-l1d-03.s.s1.st.0.r.c: Calaamaddan waxba ma sheegto 5,000. Tirada taasi waxay ka timaaddaa nooc kale oo calaamad ah.
n-k-l1d-03.s.s1.st.0.r.d: Taasi waxay noqon laheyd 3,000 won tufaax kasta, laakiin calaamaddu waxay tiraahdaa 2,000 won hal.
n-k-l1d-03.s.s1.st.1.info: Qoraal yar oo calaamadda hoosteeda: 세 개: 오천 원
n-k-l1d-03.s.s1.st.1.after: Qoraalku wuxuu bixiyaa qiimaha urur 3 tufaax: 5,000 won. Waa ka rakhiis badan 6,000 won.
n-k-l1d-03.s.s1.st.1.r.a: Taasi waxay ku darsataa 2,000 iyo 5,000, laakiin qoraalku horeba wuxuu daboolayaa saddexda tufaax.
n-k-l1d-03.s.s1.st.1.r.b: Taasi waa xisaabtii hore. Qoraalka cusub wuxuu bixiyaa qiime saddex tufaax oo sax ah.
n-k-l1d-03.s.s1.st.1.r.d: Qoraalku wuxuu leeyahay 오천 원 (5,000), ma aha 만 원 (10,000).
n-k-l1d-03.s.s1.st.2.info: Waraaq cas oo taagga ah: 오늘만! 세 개 사천 원
n-k-l1d-03.s.s1.st.2.ask: Waa maanta. Imisa ayaad bixisaa 3 tufaax?
n-k-l1d-03.s.s1.st.2.after: '오늘만' (maanta oo keliya) oo ay la socoto '세 개' waxay bixisaa qiimaha ugu fiican xaaladdaada saxda ah: 4,000 won.
n-k-l1d-03.s.s1.st.2.r.a: Taasi waxay ahayd qiimaha caadiga ah ee saddex. Warqadda cas waxay leedahay maanta oo keliya, maantana waa maanta.
n-k-l1d-03.s.s1.st.2.r.c: Tani waxay isku daraysaa qiimaha calaamado kala duwan. Calaamad kasta waa qiime isla 3-da tufaax ah, ma aha lacag dheeraad ah.
n-k-l1d-03.s.s1.st.2.r.d: Qiimaha hore. Laba calaamad oo cusub ayaa bixiya qiimo hoose saddexda tufaax.
n-k-l1d-03.s.s1.st.3.info: Warqad ku hoos taal midda casaanka: 어제만! 세 개 삼천 원
n-k-l1d-03.s.s1.st.3.ask: Weli waa maanta. Intee ayaad bixisaa 3 tufaax?
n-k-l1d-03.s.s1.st.3.after: Warqadda ugu cusub waa shalay, sidaa darteed ma khuseyso. Qiimaha maanta ee saddexda tufaax weli waa 4,000 won.
n-k-l1d-03.s.s1.st.3.r.a: Warqaddaasi waxay leedahay 어제만 (shalay oo keliya). Maanta ma tirsanayso.
n-k-l1d-03.s.s1.st.3.r.b: Taasi waa qiimaha caadiga ah ee saddex. Warqadda cas ee maanta weli waxay bixisaa qiime hoose.
n-k-l1d-03.s.s1.st.3.r.c: Tani waxay isku daraysaa 4,000 iyo 3,000, laakiin calaamad kasta waxay bixisaa qiime isla 3-da tufaax ah.
n-k-l1d-03.s.s1.reflect: Calaamad cusub kasta waxay ka hadashay xaalad ka cad (marka hore hal tufaax, kadibna saddex tufaax saxda ah, kadibna saddex tufaax maanta). Calaamadda ka cad ayaa guuleysata, sidaa darteed jawaabtaadu laba jeer ayay isbeddeshay. Warqadda ugu dambeysay waxay ahayd tan ugu cusub, laakiin waxay ahayd shalay, sidaa darteed jawaabtaada ma beddelin: hubi inay calaamaddu ku habboon tahay xaaladdaada kahor intaadan isticmaalin.
n-k-l1d-03.s.s2.prompt: Waxaad u dhowaataa dukaanleeyaha. Kuuriyaan, codso 3 tufaax oo weydii qiimaha (hadal edeb leh).
n-k-l1d-03.s.s2.hint.0: Ku bilow midhaha iyo lambarka, kadibna erayga codsiga.
n-k-l1d-03.s.s2.hint.1: Tufaaxa ku tiri 한, 두, 세 + 개; ku dhammee su'aal qiimo.
n-k-l1d-03.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Ma idhi tufaax, lambarka saddex iyo codsiga?
n-k-l1d-03.s.s2.selfAssess.2: Ma isticmaalay 세 개 ma aha 삼 개?
n-k-l1d-03.s.s2.modelNote.1: Wuxuu si toos ah u hubiyaa qiimaha dhimista.
n-k-l1d-03.s.s2.modelNote.3: Weydiinta qiimaha saddexda tufaax sidoo kale waa dabiici.

n-k-l1d-04.title: Maxay qoysku bixiyaan?
n-k-l1d-04.goal: Go'aami xaqiiqada maqan ee loo baahan yahay si loo xisaabiyo qiimaha tigidhka qoyska, xisaabi, oo karraaniga u sheeg xaqiiqooyinka muhiimka ah.
n-k-l1d-04.material:
Waxaad ku jirtaa daaqadda tigidhada beerta xayawaanka qoyskaaga la jirta: laba qof oo waaweyn iyo laba carruur ah. Calaamaddu waxay leedahay:

[동물원 표]
어른: 오천 원
아이: 삼천 원
다섯 살까지: 0원

(Sadarka ugu dambeeya macnaheedu waa: carruurta ilaa 5 jir waxba ma bixiyaan.)
n-k-l1d-04.thinking.1: Shuruud qarsoon oo ku jirta xeer qiimo
n-k-l1d-04.thinking.2: Tirinta dadka (명) iyo da'da (살) adigoo isticmaalaya lambarrada Kuuriyaanka asalka ah
n-k-l1d-04.prereq.1: Wuxuu yaqaan qiimaha Sino-Kuuriyaanka (오천 원, 삼천 원)
n-k-l1d-04.prereq.2: Wuxuu yaqaan lambarrada asalka ah ee 명 iyo 살 (두 명, 네 살, 여덟 살)
n-k-l1d-04.s.s1.prompt: Waxaad rabtaa inaad karraaniga u sheegto qiimaha qoyska. Xaqiiqadee ayaad WELI u baahan tahay kahor intaadan xisaabin kari?
n-k-l1d-04.s.s1.hint.0: Akhri saddexda sadar ee calaamadda oo hoos u xarriiq sadarka ku xidhan xaqiiqo aanad haysan.
n-k-l1d-04.s.s1.hint.1: Macluumaadka qoyskaaga la barbar dhig sadar kasta: sadarkee ayaa u baahan wax aan laguu sheegin?
n-k-l1d-04.s.s1.r.a: Horeyba calaamadda ayuu ku yaal: 5,000 won.
n-k-l1d-04.s.s1.o.c: Haddii carruurtu yihiin wiilal ama gabdho
n-k-l1d-04.s.s1.r.c: Calaamaddu xeer ku saabsan wiilal iyo gabdho ma leh.
n-k-l1d-04.s.s1.r.d: Calaamaddu ma laha xeer da' ee dadka waaweyn; dadka waaweyn waxay bixiyaan 5,000 won.
n-k-l1d-04.s.s1.explain: Calaamaddu waxay leedahay shuruud qarsoon: carruurta ilaa 5 jir waxay bixiyaan 0 won, carruurta kale na waxay bixiyaan 3,000 won. Waxaad ogtahay inay jiraan laba carruur ah laakiin ma ogtid da'dooda, sidaa darteed ma sheegi kartid qiimaha weli.
n-k-l1d-04.s.s2.prompt: Hal ilmo waa 네 살 kan kalena waa 여덟 살. Intee bixiyaan qoysku?
n-k-l1d-04.s.s2.hint.0: Afarta qof u kala saar yaa bixiya 5,000, yaa bixiya 3,000, yaa bixiya 0.
n-k-l1d-04.s.s2.hint.1: Ku dar dadka waxa bixiya oo keliya.
n-k-l1d-04.s.s2.r.a: Tani waxay labada carruur kasta ka qaadaysaa 3,000 won, laakiin ilmo 4 jir ah wuxuu bixiyaa 0.
n-k-l1d-04.s.s2.r.b: Tani waxay labada carruur u daawaaneysaa kuwo bilaash ah; kan 8 jirka ah sadarka bilaashka ah ma daboolayo.
n-k-l1d-04.s.s2.r.c: Tani waxay tirinaysaa hal qof oo weyn iyo hal ilmo oo keliya.
n-k-l1d-04.s.s2.explain: Laba qof oo waaweyn waxay bixiyaan 5,000 x 2 = 10,000 won. Kan 8 jirka ah wuxuu bixiyaa 3,000 won. Kan 4 jirka ah wuxuu bixiyaa 0. Wadarta: 13,000 won.
n-k-l1d-04.s.s3.prompt: Karraaniga u sheeg Kuuriyaan (hadal edeb leh): yaa qoyskaaga ku jira (dadka waaweyn iyo carruurta, lambarro leh) iyo imisa jir ay carruurtu yihiin, kadibna weydii qiimaha.
n-k-l1d-04.s.s3.hint.0: Marka hore dheh dadka waaweyn, kadibna carruurta, adigoo isticmaalaya 명.
n-k-l1d-04.s.s3.hint.1: Ku dar labada da' adigoo isticmaalaya 살, kadibna ku dhammee su'aal qiimo.
n-k-l1d-04.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ma idhi imisa qof oo waaweyn iyo imisa carruur ah?

n-k-l1d-05.title: Ma 일, 이, 삼 wax walba samayn karaan?
n-k-l1d-05.topic: Laba nidaam oo lambar ah iyo erayada tirinta
n-k-l1d-05.goal: Tijaabi xeerka barte in lambarrada Sino (일, 이, 삼) meel walba ay shaqeeyaan, sheeg qaabka dhabta ah, oo qor labadaada weedh oo muujinaya.
n-k-l1d-05.material:
Tom wuxuu baranayaa Kuuriyaan. Wuxuu leeyahay: "I know 일, 이, 삼, 사, 오 ... so I will use only these numbers for everything!"

Halkan waxaa ku yaal lix weedhood oo Tom qoray:
n-k-l1d-05.thinking.0: Helidda tusaalayaal lid ku ah xeer
n-k-l1d-05.thinking.1: Sheegidda xeer ku habboon caddayn kasta
n-k-l1d-05.prereq.1: Wuxuu yaqaan 하나 둘 셋 / 한 두 세 iyo 일 이 삼
n-k-l1d-05.prereq.2: Wuxuu la kulmay erayada 개, 명, 살, 시, 원, 분, 월, 일, 번
n-k-l1d-05.s.s1.prompt: Weedhaha Tom ee kee ayaa u dhawaaqi lahaa khalad qof Kuuriyaan ah? Dooro mid kasta.
n-k-l1d-05.s.s1.hint.0: Lixda weedhood mid mid codka kor u dheh. Kuwee ayaad nolosha dhabta ah ku maqashay lambar Sino ah, kuwee na mid asal ah?
n-k-l1d-05.s.s1.hint.1: Weedh kasta maskaxda ku dheh. Kuwee ayaad ku maqashay lambarro sida 하나, 둘, 셋?
n-k-l1d-05.s.s1.r.b: Tani waa sax: lacagtu waxay isticmaashaa lambarrada Sino (이만 원 = 20,000 won).
n-k-l1d-05.s.s1.r.d: Tani waa sax: bilaha iyo maalmaha waxay isticmaalaan lambarrada Sino (5월 5일).
n-k-l1d-05.s.s1.r.f: Tani waa sax: lambarrada baska iyo jidadka waxay isticmaalaan lambarrada Sino.
n-k-l1d-05.s.s1.explain: Saddex weedhood waa khalad sababtoo ah 개 (shay), 살 (da') iyo 명 (dad) waxay u baahan yihiin lambarro asal ah: 의자 두 개, 다섯 살, 학생이 다섯 명. Saddexda kale way fiican yihiin: lacag (원), taariikho (월, 일) iyo lambarro sida baska 3 waxay isticmaalaan lambarrada Sino.
n-k-l1d-05.s.s2.prompt: Xeerkee ayaa ku habboon LIXDA weedhood oo dhan?
n-k-l1d-05.s.s2.hint.0: Samee laba tiir: weedhaha khaldan iyo kuwa saxda ah. Maxaa isku mid ah tiir kasta?
n-k-l1d-05.s.s2.hint.1: Xeer kasta tijaabi weedh uu sharxi lahaa. Ma sharxaa kuwa kale sidoo kale?
n-k-l1d-05.s.s2.o.a: Labada nooc ee lambarrada had iyo jeer way fiican yihiin; hadluhu si xor ah ayuu u doortaa.
n-k-l1d-05.s.s2.r.a: Saddex weedhood waxay u dhawaaqaan khalad, sidaa darteed doorashadu ma aha mid xor ah.
n-k-l1d-05.s.s2.o.b: Erayga aad tirinayso ayaa go'aamiya nidaamka lambarka ee ku habboon.
n-k-l1d-05.s.s2.o.c: Lambarrada yar yar waa kuwo asal ah (하나, 둘 ...) kuwa waaweyn na waa Sino (이십오, 이만 ...).
n-k-l1d-05.s.s2.r.c: 오월 오 일 wuxuu isticmaalaa lambarka yar 5 sida Sino, 이십오 살 na waa weyn laakiin wuxuu u baahan yahay 스물다섯 ee asal ah, sidaa darteed cabbirku ma go'aamiyo.
n-k-l1d-05.s.s2.o.d: Lambarrada asalka ah waa hadal caadi ah, lambarrada Sino na waa hadal edeb leh.
n-k-l1d-05.s.s2.r.d: Isla lambarrada ayaa ka muuqda hadalka edebta: 세 개 주세요 iyo 이만 원이에요 labaduba waa edeb.
n-k-l1d-05.s.s2.explain: Erayga tirinta ayaa go'aamiya. Shayada, dadka, da'da iyo saacadaha (개, 명, 살, 시) waxay isticmaalaan lambarro asal ah; lacagta, daqiiqooyinka, bilaha, maalmaha iyo lambarrada sida baska 3 (원, 분, 월, 일, 번) waxay isticmaalaan lambarro Sino ah.

n-k-l1a-01.title: Junho wuxuu codka kor ugu akhriyaa summadaha dukaanka
n-k-l1a-01.topic: Akhrinta Hangul: shaqalo is u eg
n-k-l1a-01.goal: Hel akhrinta liiska fasal-wadaage ee isku qaldaya shaqalo is u eg, magacow nooca khaladka, oo qor akhrinta saxda ah.
n-k-l1a-01.material: Junho wuxuu baranayaa Hangul. Wuxuu akhriyaa lix summad oo dukaan ah codka kor ah oo wuxuu qoraa akhrintiisa erayada agtooda. Qiimaha xarafaha ee la isticmaalayo: ㅏ = a, ㅓ = eo (sida 'uh'), ㅗ = o, ㅜ = u, ㅣ = i, ㅡ = eu; ㄱ = g, ㄴ = n, ㄷ = d, ㅁ = m, ㅂ = b, ㄹ = r/l; block ka bilaabma ㅇ wuxuu ka bilaabmaa dhawaaq shaqal ah. Akhrinta qaarkood ee Junho waa khalad.
n-k-l1a-01.thinking.2: Saxidda iyadoo tilmaan xusuus la isticmaalayo
n-k-l1a-01.prereq.0: Wuxuu yaqaan xarafaha Hangul iyo dhawaaqooda aasaasiga ah
n-k-l1a-01.s.s1.prompt: Dooro hal sadar halka akhrinta Junho aysan waafaqsanayn Hangul. (Sadar ka badan hal ayaa khalad ah.)
n-k-l1a-01.s.s1.hint.0: Block kasta adigu akhri adigoo isticmaalaya qiimaha xarafaha, kadibna akhrintaada la barbar dhig tan Junho.
n-k-l1a-01.s.s1.hint.1: Isbarbar dhig shaqalka block kasta iyo shaqalka akhrintiisa, block-block.
n-k-l1a-01.s.s1.explain: Sadarrada 2 iyo 4 waa khalad. 구두 wuxuu leeyahay ㅜ (u), sidaa darteed waa gu-du, ma aha go-du. 거미 wuxuu leeyahay ㅓ (eo), sidaa darteed waa geo-mi, ma aha ga-mi. Afarta sadar ee kale way waafaqsan yihiin.
n-k-l1a-01.s.s2.hint.0: Ku taxay xarafaha isbeddelay u dhexeeya Hangul iyo akhrinta Junho sadar kasta oo khaldan.
n-k-l1a-01.s.s2.hint.1: Ma isbeddelku waa shibbane, shaqal, mise kala horreynta blocks-ka?
n-k-l1a-01.s.s2.o.a: Wuxuu isku qaldamay laba shibbane oo isu eg (tusaale ㄱ iyo ㅋ).
n-k-l1a-01.s.s2.r.a: Shibbanayaasha sadarrada khaldan (ㄱ, ㄷ, ㅁ) si sax ah ayaa loo akhriyay (g, d, m). Isbeddelku wuxuu ku jiraa shaqalka.
n-k-l1a-01.s.s2.o.b: Wuxuu isku qaldamay shaqalo is u eg: xarriiqda yar ayaa dhinaca kale ama dhamaadka kale ah (ㅜ/ㅗ, ㅓ/ㅏ).
n-k-l1a-01.s.s2.o.c: Wuxuu akhriyay blocks-ka kala horreyn khaldan, block-ka ugu dambeeya marka hore.
n-k-l1a-01.s.s2.r.c: Labada akhris labaduba waxay ilaaliyaan kala horreynta blocks-ka (go-du waxay leedahay isla kala horreyn sida gu-du). Dhawaaq shaqal oo keliya ayaa isbeddelay.
n-k-l1a-01.s.s2.o.d: Wuxuu ilaawey in ㅇ block-ka bilowgiisa aanu lahayn dhawaaq.
n-k-l1a-01.s.s2.r.d: Erayada ay ku bilaabmeen ㅇ (우유) si sax ah ayaa loo akhriyay, sadarrada khaldan na ma leh ㅇ bilow ah.
n-k-l1a-01.s.s2.explain: Labada sadar ee khaldan labadooda shaqalku wuu isbeddelay: ㅜ wuxuu noqday o, ㅓ na wuxuu noqday a. Labadan lammaane waxay ku kala duwan yihiin meesha xarriiqda gaaban saaran tahay oo keliya. Shaqalada is u eg waa khalad caadi ah oo koowaad.
n-k-l1a-01.s.s3.prompt: Qor akhrinta saxda ah ee labada eray ee khaldan xarfo Laatiin ah (sida 'na-mu'), kadibna ku dar hal talo gaaban oo Junho ka caawisa kala saarida shaqalada is u eg.
n-k-l1a-01.s.s3.hint.0: Isbarbar dhig akhrintaada labada eray ee khaldan block-block.
n-k-l1a-01.s.s3.hint.1: Talada waa inay sheegtaa halka xarriiqda gaaban tahay (kor, hoos, bidix ama midig ee xarriiqda dheer).
n-k-l1a-01.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ma akhris kasta wuxuu ka samaysan yahay qiimaha xarafaha la bixiyay oo keliya?
n-k-l1a-01.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ma taladaydu waxay sheegaysaa halka xarriiqda shaqal kasta tahay?
n-k-l1a-01.s.s3.model.0: gu-du iyo geo-mi. Talo: ㅜ xarriiqdeedu waa xariiqda hoosteeda, ㅗ na waa kor.
n-k-l1a-01.s.s3.model.1: 구두 = gudu, 거미 = geomi. Talo: ㅓ xarriiqda gaaban waxay tilmaamaysaa dhinaca bidix, ㅏ na waa dhinaca midig.
n-k-l1a-01.s.s3.model.2: gu-du / geo-mi. Xusuuso: shaqalka 'kor' ㅗ waa o, shaqalka 'hoos' ㅜ waa u.

n-k-l1a-02.title: Xarafka yar ee hoose ma qurxin oo keliya baa?
n-k-l1a-02.topic: Akhrinta Hangul: shibbanaha dhammaadka (받침) wuxuu beddelaa erayga
n-k-l1a-02.goal: Ku xukun sheegasho fasal-wadaage ee ku saabsan shibbanaha dhammaadka (받침) adigoo isticmaalaya caddayn ka timaadda summadda qiimaha iyo lacag bixin, oo erayadaada ku sharax.
n-k-l1a-02.material: Suuq dukaan, Jiwoo iyo Hajun waxay eegayaan summadda qiimaha ee kiish tufaax ah. Lambarrada aad u baahan tahay: 이 = 2, 삼 = 3, 사 = 4, 오 = 5, 천 = 1,000 (sidaa darteed 이천 원 = 2,000 won). Jiwoo summadda waxay u akhriyaysaa 삼천 원. Hajun wuxuu leeyahay: 'Xarafka yar ee hoose ee block waa qurxin oo keliya, sidaa darteed 삼 iyo 사 isku mid ayay yihiin oo anigu waxaan akhriyaa 사천 원.'
n-k-l1a-02.thinking.0: Tijaabinta sheegasho iyadoo caddayn la isticmaalayo
n-k-l1a-02.thinking.1: Arkidda in faahfaahin yar ay beddeli karto macnaha
n-k-l1a-02.prereq.0: Wuxuu akhriyi karaa blocks Hangul oo leh shibbane dhammaad
n-k-l1a-02.prereq.1: Wuxuu yaqaan lambarrada 이, 삼, 사, 오 iyo 천
n-k-l1a-02.s.s1.prompt: Tijaabi xeerka Hajun liiska lambarrada: maxay xeerku ka sheegayaan blocks-ka 삼 iyo 사, ma waafaqsan yahay liiska?
n-k-l1a-02.s.s1.hint.0: Farta ku daboolo xarafka hoose ee 삼. Block kee ayaa hadhay?
n-k-l1a-02.s.s1.hint.1: Block-kaas la barbar dhig liiska lambarrada. Xeerku ma weli bixin lahaa laba lambar oo kala duwan?
n-k-l1a-02.s.s1.o.a: Isku eray ayay noqon lahaayeen, taasna waxay waafaqsan tahay liiska: 삼 = 3 iyo 사 = 3.
n-k-l1a-02.s.s1.r.a: Liisku taas ma yiraahdo. Wuxuu bixiyaa 삼 = 3 iyo 사 = 4, laba lambar oo kala duwan.
n-k-l1a-02.s.s1.o.b: Waxay u eg yihiin kuwo kala duwan gacan-qorka, laakiin daabacaadda waa isku block.
n-k-l1a-02.s.s1.r.b: Daabacaadda sidoo kale, 삼 iyo 사 waa laba block oo kala duwan: mid wuxuu leeyahay ㅁ hoos, midka kalena waxba.
n-k-l1a-02.s.s1.o.c: Waxay noqon lahaayeen isku eray xeerka hoostiisa, laakiin liisku wuxuu bixiyaa 삼 = 3 iyo 사 = 4, sidaa darteed xeerku wuu fashilmayaa.
n-k-l1a-02.s.s1.o.d: Xeerku ma taabto, sababtoo ah midkoodna ma laha xaraf hoose.
n-k-l1a-02.s.s1.r.d: Block-ka 삼 wuxuu leeyahay ㅁ hoosta shaqalka. Taasi waa saxda ah xarafka hoose ee xeerku ka hadlayo.
n-k-l1a-02.s.s1.explain: Block Hangul waxaa loo akhriyaa sida wada jira, oo ay ku jirto shibbanaha dhammaadka. Haddii xarafka hoose uu ahaan lahaa qurxin, 삼 iyo 사 isku eray ayay ahaan lahaayeen, laakiin liisku wuxuu leeyahay 삼 (sam) = 3 iyo 사 (sa) = 4. Sidaa darteed xeerku wuu fashilmay; akhrinta Jiwoo 삼천 원 waa tan lagu hubinayo lacag bixinta.
n-k-l1a-02.s.s2.prompt: Caddayn cusub: Jiwoo waxay ku bixisaa waraaqad 5,000 won oo shaqaalaha ayaa u celiyay 2,000 won. Summaddee ayay taageertaa tani?
n-k-l1a-02.s.s2.hint.0: Xisaabi inta Jiwoo ku kharashtay: lacagta la bixiyay laga jaro soo noqoshada.
n-k-l1a-02.s.s2.hint.1: Hubi afarta summadood midda siisa xaddigaas.
n-k-l1a-02.s.s2.r.b: Markaas 5,000 - 2,000 = 3,000 wuxuu noqon lahaa soo noqoshada, ma aha 2,000.
n-k-l1a-02.s.s2.r.c: Markaas soo noqoshadu waxay noqon lahayd 1,000 won.
n-k-l1a-02.s.s2.explain: 5,000 - 2,000 = 3,000. Lacag bixintu waxay la jaan qaadaa akhrinta Jiwoo 삼천 원 ma aha tan Hajun 사천 원, sidaa darteed xarafka hoose muhiim buu ahaa.
n-k-l1a-02.s.s3.prompt: Hal ama laba weedhood u sharax Hajun sababta xarafka hoose u ahayn qurxin. Isticmaal summadda 삼천 원 sida tusaalahaaga.
n-k-l1a-02.s.s3.hint.0: Isbarbar dhig 삼 iyo 사 xaraf-xaraf.
n-k-l1a-02.s.s3.hint.1: Dheh waxa xarafka dheeraadka ahi ku daro block-ka iyo lambarka block kasta u taagan yahay.
n-k-l1a-02.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ma idhi waxa xarafka hoose ku sameeyo block-ka?
n-k-l1a-02.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ma tusay lammaane block ah, sida 삼 iyo 사?
n-k-l1a-02.s.s3.model.0: Xarafka hoose ee ㅁ waa qayb ka mid ah block-ka. Isagoo la'aan block-ku waa 사 (4); isagoo jira waa 삼 (3). Sidaa darteed summaddu waxay leedahay 3,000 won, ma aha 4,000.
n-k-l1a-02.s.s3.model.1: 삼 iyo 사 waa erayo kala duwan: 삼 = 3 iyo 사 = 4. Xarafka hoose wuxuu beddelaa lambarka, sidaa darteed ma aha qurxin.
n-k-l1a-02.s.s3.model.2: Xarafka hoose wuxuu beddelaa erayga: 가 iyo 간 waa erayo kala duwan. Sidaas oo kale 삼 (3) iyo 사 (4) way kala duwan yihiin, sidaa darteed xarafka hoose wuu muhiim yahay.

n-k-l1a-03.title: Calaamadda jeexjeexan ee albaabka sare
n-k-l1a-03.topic: Akhrinta Hangul: blocks-ka higgaadda ee calaamadaha
n-k-l1a-03.goal: Go'aami macluumaadka loo baahan yahay si loo akhriyo calaamad qayb ahaan daboolan, dheh waxa aad hubto, oo akhri erayga ugu dambeeya marka wax dheeraad ah la muujiyo.
n-k-l1a-03.material: Calaamad albaabka ka sarraysa dukaan weyn ayaa jeexjeexan. Waxaad akhrisan kartaa labada block ee hore oo keliya: 화장. Laba eray oo dabaqan ayaa sidan ku bilaabma: 화장실 (suuliga) iyo 화장품 (qurxinta). Waxaad rabtaa suuliga.
n-k-l1a-03.thinking.0: Arkidda waxa laba eray oo suurtagal ah wadaagaan
n-k-l1a-03.thinking.1: Kala saaridda waxa hubaal ah iyo waxa aan hubin
n-k-l1a-03.prereq.1: Wuxuu yaqaan 화장실 iyo 화장품 sida erayo
n-k-l1a-03.s.s1.prompt: Kuwa soo socdaa kee ayaa kaa caawin lahaa inaad ogaato erayga calaamaddu leedahay?
n-k-l1a-03.s.s1.hint.0: Labada eray suurtagal ah ku qor mid kale hoostiisa oo hoos u xarriiq waxa isku mid ah.
n-k-l1a-03.s.s1.hint.1: Weydii qaybta calaamadda ee labada eray ka duwanaan karto.
n-k-l1a-03.s.s1.o.a: Dib u akhrinta labada block ee hore (화장) si tartiib ah.
n-k-l1a-03.s.s1.r.a: Labada eray labaduba waxay ku bilaabmaan isla labada block, 화장, sidaa darteed dib u akhrinta ma kala saari karto erayada.
n-k-l1a-03.s.s1.o.b: Arkidda block-ka ka dambeeya 화장 ee calaamadda.
n-k-l1a-03.s.s1.r.c: Midabku ma aha qayb ka mid ah erayga la qoray; laba albaab midab kasta leh ayaa qaadi kara mid kasta oo erayada ah.
n-k-l1a-03.s.s1.r.d: Dabaqu wuxuu kuu sheegaa halka aad joogto, ma aha kuwee ayaa labada eray calaamadda jeexjeexan muujisaa.
n-k-l1a-03.s.s1.explain: Labada eray waxay ku kala duwan yihiin block-ka saddexaad oo keliya (실 ama 품). Labada block ee hore waa la wadaagaa, sidaa darteed block-ka saddexaad oo keliya ayaa go'aamin kara.
n-k-l1a-03.s.s2.prompt: Saaxiib ayaa wacaya oo weydiinaya: 'Maxay calaamaddu tiraahdaa?' Ku jawaab hal ama laba weedhood oo gaagaaban (Kuuriyaan ama Ingiriisi): dheh waxa aad hubto inaad akhriyi karto iyo waxa aadan weli awoodin.
n-k-l1a-03.s.s2.hint.1: Ku dar waxa aad weli u baahan tahay inaad aragto kahor intaadan erayga magacaabin.
n-k-l1a-03.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Ma kala saaray qaybta aan akhriyi karo iyo qaybta aanan awoodin?
n-k-l1a-03.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Ma ka fogaaday inaan dooran eray keliya caddayn la'aan?
n-k-l1a-03.s.s2.model.0: Waan akhriyi karaa 화장, laakiin weli ma garanayo xubinta saddexaad. Waxay noqon kartaa 화장실 ama 화장품.
n-k-l1a-03.s.s2.model.1: Labada xubnood ee ugu horreeya waxay leeyihiin 화장. Ma odhan karo eraygii oo dhan ilaa aan arko xubinta saddexaad.
n-k-l1a-03.s.s2.model.3: Waan akhriyi karaa 화장 laakiin weli ma akhriyi karo xubinta saddexaad; waa inaan arko si aan u ogaado eraygii.
n-k-l1a-03.s.s3.prompt: Dhaqaaqii waa la dhaqaajiyay xubinta saddexaadna waa muuqataa. Waxay ka samaysan tahay ㅍ (kor), ㅜ (shaqal) iyo ㅁ (hoose). Albaabkee ayuu yahay?
n-k-l1a-03.s.s3.hint.0: Isku dar xarafka sare, shaqalka iyo xarafka hoose hal xubin.
n-k-l1a-03.s.s3.hint.1: Is barbardhig xubintaas iyo labada xubnood ee musharaxiinta ah 실 iyo 품.
n-k-l1a-03.s.s3.r.a: Erayga musqushu wuxuu leeyahay xubinta 실; xarfaha la bixiyay waxay sameeyaan xubin kale, 품.
n-k-l1a-03.s.s3.o.b: Mid kasta; labada xubnood ee ugu horreeya way ku filan yihiin.
n-k-l1a-03.s.s3.r.b: Xubinta saddexaad ayaa go'aamisa u dhexeeya labada eray hadda-na waa muuqataa.
n-k-l1a-03.s.s3.r.d: Dhammaan saddexda xubnood hadda waa la akhriyi karaa, sidaas darteed calaamadda waa la akhriyi karaa.
n-k-l1a-03.s.s3.explain: Xarfaha ㅍ + ㅜ + ㅁ waxay sameeyaan xubinta 품, sidaas darteed calaamaddu waxay tiraahdaa 화장품 (qurxin). Musqushu ma ku jirto albaabkan gadaashiisa.

n-k-l1a-04.title: Waraaq ku taal darbiga makhaayad

n-k-l1a-04.thinking.2: Kala saarista laba xubnood oo is-eg

n-k-l1a-04.s.s1.st.1.r.c: Weli eray ku saabsan bilaash ama qiime ma jiro.

n-k-l1a-04.s.s1.st.1.r.d: Weli eray ku saabsan dhadhan ma jiro.
